test_case.purpose: Sustain all required subsystem loads concurrently for 12 hours at margin while every one of eight NIC paths meets its 80%-of-approved-ideal floor and all storage/GPU/memory/system health limits hold.
required_package: Full topology and eight NIC/BDF/netdev/peer/IP/port map
Pinned network, FIO, GPU and DIMM profiles with common-overlap rule
Immutable disposable FIO targets and OS/mount/RAID/data exclusion/backup
Per-NIC ideal/80% formula and subsystem load/error limits
test_case.test_command: Operator validates topology, clients, immutable scratch targets and calibrated margin, stages each bounded workload, then records a full 12-hour interval when all approved network/FIO/GPU/DIMM profiles overlap. Capture per-NIC throughput/errors, FIO integrity/latency, GPU load/thermal/Xid, memory coverage/ECC, system power/thermal/heartbeat and logs; stop cleanly, verify data/health and restore configuration/environment.
test_case.expected_result: All eight NIC paths remain at or above 80% of their signed ideals for the required statistic, all subsystem load floors and health/integrity limits hold during the complete common 12 hours, no disallowed SEL/RAS/error occurs, and restoration succeeds.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the common 12-hour overlap and every subsystem/path oracle. Aggregate traffic, sequential workloads, seven of eight NICs, unsafe FIO, shortened stress or clean SEL alone cannot pass.
safety_gate: Immutable scratch-only FIO after OS/mount/RAID/data exclusion
Verify client/feed/cooling capacity and stage loads before overlap
Abort on data, link, Xid/ECC, thermal/power or heartbeat fault
Preserve evidence, no auto-retry, full cleanup/restoration
test_case.recovery: On any subsystem or environment fault, stop new I/O/load in the approved order, preserve synchronized artifacts, protect storage data, use OOB as needed, restore network/workload/environment state and do not automatically rerun.
